Six sources before it ever guesses.

Barcodes are checked against FatSecret, Open Food Facts, USDA, Open Beauty Facts, Go-UPC and UPCitemdb. Search merges results rather than dropping them, so USDA macros keep Open Food Facts ingredient lists. AI is the last resort, not the first.

It reads the ingredients, not just the calories.

Seed oils, the NOVA ultra-processing rating, named additives with a severity for each, and allergen alerts — an ingredient-by-ingredient breakdown of what is actually in the packet.

Type it. Don’t weigh it.

Two eggs, sourdough, half an avocado. Back comes calories, protein, carbs, fat, fibre, sugar, sodium and more — into the same sheet as any barcode scan. And when search comes up empty, it works out whether you asked about a generic food, a major brand, a store brand or a chain restaurant, and looks each one up differently.

Frequently asked questions

The things people ask before they download.

Do I need an account to try it?+

No. You answer the setup questions and see your finished plan first — calorie and macro targets, a goal timeline with dated milestones, and the goal that actually fits your body composition. Signing in with Apple or Google is the last screen, not the first. Quit halfway and it resumes on the same question with your answers intact.

What happens to my health data?+

CŌR reads steps, energy, workouts, heart rate, HRV, sleep, weight and body fat from Apple Health, and writes back your workouts, weight, body fat, water and meal macros. Your summaries sync to your private CŌR account so your history follows you across devices. AI coaching is a separate, explicit opt-in that stays off until you turn it on, with per-feature toggles in Settings. Your health data is never used for advertising and never sold.

What do I get without paying?+

The full manual workout tracker — live sessions, adaptive rest timer, set types, RPE, PR detection and the next-weight prediction. Food search across USDA, Open Food Facts and the community database. Manual logging and saved meals. Body measurements and Navy-formula body fat. Your weekly score with the complete pillar breakdown. Weight trend, fasting timer, and two-way Apple Health sync.

How is the score calculated?+

Four pillars: Nutrition 35, Training 35, Hydration 15, Recovery 15. Each shows points earned against its cap, so the four add up to your score and you can check the arithmetic yourself. If there is no sleep data, Recovery is dropped and the rest renormalise rather than filling in a made-up number — and a new account sees Building your baseline instead of a discouraging score on day one.

Does it work on Apple Watch?+

Yes. You can run a whole session from your wrist — log sets, edit weight and reps, and rate effort — and it stays in sync with your phone. While you train, the workout also runs as a Live Activity on your lock screen.
